label: Interactive media
tagline: TouchDesigner-flavoured pieces the user drives with body or device
description: Orchestrates a generative interactive piece where the user's body/device (mic, camera, mouse, gyro, MIDI, gamepad) becomes a creative material and the output is real-time generative response (shader, particles, 3D, audio). Researches the tech stack, commits a buildTier (simple|standard|full), scaffolds a tier-sized builder set, and hands back. The build-driver (chat) dispatches each builder in dependency order (input(s) → mapping → output(s) → runtime, runtime LAST = composer) with NO per-drawer lens, then runs a SINGLE final QA+lens gate on the assembled runtime (GET /__qa/run?node=<container>&mode=interactive + the craft/aesthetic/concept lens trio ONCE; pass = QA ok AND ≥2/3 lenses pass). Cross-channel coherence is judged at that gate, not in a separate step. Permission UX gates camera/mic via two-gate pattern (canvas-side + iframe-side Start). Two cross-boundary contracts beyond the final gate: §1.2 iframe ↔ host pointer + scroll contract (touch-action policy honest about declared inputs, Start-gate release after gating, allow= attribute coverage, scroll-past affordance for hero-slot pointer-input pieces) and §5.6 Phase F layered-interaction QA + fix pass - catches Start-gate splash forgetting to release pointer-events, getUserMedia double-prompts, allow= attribute mismatches.

triggers.title: build an app with this piece
triggers.rule: User wants the interactive piece embedded in an app. Top-level Claude scaffolds the app shell (with im-placeholder slot + allow= attribute), then dispatches interactive-media-orchestrator per slot (). After hand-off, Claude drives the build per the shared model in editor/kinds/capabilities.py (builders in dependency order, runtime LAST, NO per-drawer lens, then a SINGLE final QA+lens gate on the assembled runtime) and embeds the runtime.
